label: Bright, Clear & Charismatic (based on V4 preview 3)

request.voice_description: A young American man, around twenty-two, with a bright, clear and distinctive mid-to-high register. His voice is warm and youthful with only a faint touch of texture: not deep, not heavily raspy, and never shrill or strained. He tells mysteries and unbelievable true stories the way a charismatic friend would: lively, natural and conversational, confident and emotionally expressive. His intonation moves noticeably, with clear shifts in emphasis and rhythm: he leans into key words, picks up speed with excitement, slows down and softens for suspense, and lets short, natural pauses land. Crisp, clear General American articulation that still sounds relaxed and human. Not monotone, not robotic, not announcer-like or overly polished. Clean, close-mic studio recording.
request.text: On December 4th, 1872, the crew of the ship Dei Gratia spotted a vessel near the Azores. It was the Mary Celeste. But now, all ten were gone. And the strangest part? The ship was still seaworthy.
